nodes.name: ClubSpark Package Import Queue Review Webhook

parameters.jsCode:
const source = $input.first()?.json ?? {};
const query = source.query ?? source;
const headers = source.headers ?? {};
const clean = (value) => value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value).trim();
const deriveBaseUrl = (headers, fallback) => {
  const forwardedProto = clean(headers['x-forwarded-proto']);
  const forwardedHost = clean(headers['x-forwarded-host']);
  const host = forwardedHost || clean(headers.host);
  const forwardedPort = clean(headers['x-forwarded-port']);
  if (!host) return fallback;
  const proto = forwardedProto || 'http';
  let authority = host;
  if (forwardedPort && !authority.includes(':')) {
    const isDefaultPort = (proto === 'http' && forwardedPort === '80') || (proto === 'https' && forwardedPort === '443');
    if (!isDefaultPort) authority = `${authority}:${forwardedPort}`;
  }
  return `${proto}://${authority}`;
};
const sqlLiteral = (value) => `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
const rawBatchId = clean(query.batch_id ?? query.batchId);
const rawTargetMembership = clean(query.target_membership ?? query.targetMembership);
const parsedBatchId = Number.parseInt(rawBatchId, 10);
const fallbackBaseUrl = 'http://n8n:5678';
const n8nBaseUrl = deriveBaseUrl(headers, fallbackBaseUrl);
if (!Number.isInteger(parsedBatchId) || parsedBatchId <= 0) {
  return [{ json: { batch_id: rawBatchId, target_membership: rawTargetMembership, response_code: 400, n8n_base_url: n8nBaseUrl, sql: "SELECT NULL::bigint AS batch_id, false AS batch_exists, NULL::text AS status, NULL::timestamptz AS created_at, NULL::timestamptz AS completed_at, 0::bigint AS total_rows, 0::bigint AS queued_rows, 0::bigint AS exported_rows, 0::bigint AS imported_rows, 0::bigint AS cancelled_rows, '[]'::json AS items, '[]'::json AS package_groups;" } }];
}
const targetMembershipFilter = rawTargetMembership ? `AND q.target_membership = ${sqlLiteral(rawTargetMembership)}` : '';
const sql = `
WITH requested AS (
  SELECT ${sqlLiteral(parsedBatchId)}::bigint AS batch_id,
         NULLIF(${sqlLiteral(rawTargetMembership)}::text, '') AS target_membership_filter
),
batch_base AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.status, b.created_at, b.completed_at
  FROM public.signup_batches b
  JOIN requested r ON r.batch_id = b.id
),
queue_rows AS (
  SELECT
    q.id,
    q.batch_id,
    q.raw_member_id,
    q.member,
    q.email_address,
    q.source_membership,
    q.target_membership,
    q.status,
    q.notes,
    q.created_at,
    q.created_by,
    q.exported_at,
    q.imported_at,
    q.export_file_name,
    q.clubspark_package_id,
    q.clubspark_import_url,
    q.british_tennis_number,
    COALESCE(rm.is_current, false) AS raw_member_is_current,
    CASE WHEN rm.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS raw_member_exists,
    rm."Status" AS current_member_status,
    rm."Membership" AS current_membership
  FROM public.vw_signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
  LEFT JOIN public.raw_members rm
    ON rm.id = q.raw_member_id
  WHERE q.batch_id = ${sqlLiteral(parsedBatchId)}::bigint
    ${targetMembershipFilter}
),
items_json AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'id', id,
        'batch_id', batch_id,
        'raw_member_id', raw_member_id,
        'member', member,
        'email_address', email_address,
        'source_membership', source_membership,
        'target_membership', target_membership,
        'status', status,
        'notes', notes,
        'created_at', created_at,
        'created_by', created_by,
        'exported_at', exported_at,
        'imported_at', imported_at,
        'export_file_name', export_file_name,
        'raw_member_exists', raw_member_exists,
        'raw_member_is_current', raw_member_is_current,
        'current_member_status', current_member_status,
        'current_membership', current_membership,
        'clubspark_package_id', clubspark_package_id,
        'clubspark_import_url', clubspark_import_url,
        'british_tennis_number', british_tennis_number
      )
      ORDER BY CASE status
        WHEN 'queued' THEN 0
        WHEN 'exported' THEN 1
        WHEN 'imported' THEN 2
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 3
        ELSE 9 END,
      target_membership,
      member,
      id
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS items
  FROM queue_rows
),
package_groups AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'target_membership', target_membership,
        'clubspark_package_id', clubspark_package_id,
        'clubspark_import_url', clubspark_import_url,
        'total_rows', total_rows,
        'queued_rows', queued_rows,
        'exported_rows', exported_rows,
        'imported_rows', imported_rows,
        'cancelled_rows', cancelled_rows
      ) ORDER BY target_membership
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS package_groups
  FROM (
    SELECT
      q.target_membership,
      MIN(q.clubspark_package_id::text) AS clubspark_package_id,
      MIN(q.clubspark_import_url) AS clubspark_import_url,
      COUNT(*)::int AS total_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'queued')::int AS queued_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'exported')::int AS exported_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'imported')::int AS imported_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'cancelled')::int AS cancelled_rows
    FROM queue_rows q
    GROUP BY q.target_membership
  ) grouped
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'queued')::int AS queued_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'exported')::int AS exported_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'imported')::int AS imported_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled')::int AS cancelled_rows
  FROM queue_rows
)
SELECT r.batch_id,
       (b.id IS NOT NULL) AS batch_exists,
       b.status,
       b.created_at,
       b.completed_at,
       COALESCE(s.total_rows, 0) AS total_rows,
       COALESCE(s.queued_rows, 0) AS queued_rows,
       COALESCE(s.exported_rows, 0) AS exported_rows,
       COALESCE(s.imported_rows, 0) AS imported_rows,
       COALESCE(s.cancelled_rows, 0) AS cancelled_rows,
       ij.items,
       pg.package_groups
FROM requested r
LEFT JOIN batch_base b ON b.id = r.batch_id
LEFT JOIN summary s ON true
CROSS JOIN items_json ij
CROSS JOIN package_groups pg;`;
return [{ json: { batch_id: parsedBatchId, target_membership: rawTargetMembership, response_code: 200, n8n_base_url: n8nBaseUrl, sql } }];
